# Rollback Controller Skill

> **Category:** Generic Skills

## Overview

Use when managing rollback operations including health monitoring, rollback execution, traffic shifting, and state restoration after deployment failures.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [rollback-controller-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
rollback-controller-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@rollback-controller` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze complex systems and decompose into manageable components
- Design solutions following established patterns and conventions
- Generate structured artifacts with consistent formatting and quality
- Validate outputs against acceptance criteria and quality gates

## Industry Standards Applied

- **SOC 2 Type II**: Trust service criteria: security, availability, processing integrity
- **ISO 27001**: Information security management system (ISMS) controls
- **GDPR/CCPA**: Data privacy and protection regulatory requirements
